name: Not Today Satan
source:
Christin lived in a very religious family and attended a catholic boarding school. At the age of eighteen, she realizes that life has more to offer. Almost daily she is confronted with the everyday temptations of life. How long will she resist? Your decision, your consequences.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Bullx_NTS]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
克里斯汀生长在一个极为虔诚的宗教家庭，并就读于一所天主教寄宿学校。十八岁那年，她意识到人生还有更多精彩等待体验。她几乎每天都要面对生活中的种种诱惑。她能抗拒多久？由你做主，后果自负。
